prompt: 读取 Reader 的所有字符后返回字符串，无论读取成功或抛 IOException，都必须关闭传入 Reader；保留 IOException 向上传播，不转为成功。

import java.io.*;
public class TextLoader {public static String load(Reader reader)throws IOException{var out=new StringBuilder();int c;while((c=reader.read())!=-1)out.append((char)c);return out.toString();}}

import java.io.*;
public class TextLoader {public static String load(Reader reader)throws IOException{try(reader){var out=new StringBuilder();char[] buffer=new char[128];int n;while((n=reader.read(buffer))!=-1)out.append(buffer,0,n);return out.toString();}}}
